question: The World Para Athletics Grand Prix 2022 was held in ________.
solution:
The correct answer is__** **____**Dubai**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **World Para Athletics Grand Prix** got underway on March 21 and last until March 24, 2022. This occasion took place in **Dubai**.
 
• There will be **450 competitors** competing from **43 different nations.**
 
• The competitors competing in this event aim to qualify for both the **Birmingham 2022 Commonwealth Games** and the **Hangzhou 2022 Asian Para Games**.
 
• **Over 100 para-athletes**, including Indian participants, have the chance to get classified in this event.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **World Para Athletics Championship**

 
 
• ​The** International Paralympic Committee's World Para Athletics** subcommittee hosts the biennial **World Para Athletics Championships**, formerly known as the **IPC Athletics World Championships before 2017 (IPC).**
 
• Athletes with intellectual and physical limitations compete in sporting competitions.
 
• **Berlin, Germany **hosted the inaugural **IPC Athletics World Championships in 1994**.
 
• They serve as a **Paralympic** equivalent of the able-bodied competitors' **World Athletics Championships.**
 
• The **IPC championships** have been conducted in the same years as the** IAAF championships** since 2011 when they changed from a quadrennial to a biennial calendar. However, they are independent competitions, and they are not always held in the same host city.
